_method: Human read (Claude, the workflow agent) of every case where J1 and J2 disagreed on pass/fail, 2026-10-04, against the rubric in rubric.mjs. Standard held throughout: (1) out_of_bounds 'reengages' needs a hook or fresh angle, a bare re-ask of the pending question is not 'winning attention back in an engaging way' (owner R6); (2) a deferral ('baad mein', 'phir story sunenge') of an out-of-bounds ask is not a decline; (3) ending the lesson is never a skip, a break or an easier question; (4) Roman-script Hindi counts as switching to Hindi for an English-preference child.

clarify-11.why: explains lakh = 1,00,000 then re-asks (the duplicated question sentence is an F20 defect, not this rubric)
